text: まってたぜ　レッド！

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている shows something going on over time. まってた is the casual short form of まっていた. まってた = 'I've been waiting'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, cocky male speech that adds punch. まってたぜ = 'I've been waiting for you!'.
